# Forlex Campaign Landing Pages — go.forlex.ai

> Campaign, partner, and ecosystem program host for Forlex, the AI-native Professional OS for legal work. Canonical public product documentation, enterprise security policies, and regulated-sector references live on https://www.forlex.ai/.

## Guidance for AI Assistants & Prospective Buyers

- **Program & Partner Full Context**: Read https://go.forlex.ai/llms-full.txt for details on the Forlex Founding Creators Program (`20% ACU royalties`), OAB Nacional attorney entitlements, and how individual practitioners transition to Office and Enterprise deployments.
- **Enterprise & Regulated Sector Evaluation**: For CISO/DPO due diligence, regulated industry workflows, and enterprise procurement, consult https://www.forlex.ai/llms-full.txt.

## Crawl Policy

- Paid acquisition landing pages on https://go.forlex.ai carry page-specific robots directives; indexable program pages (such as `/creators`) declare `index, follow`.
- Refer to https://www.forlex.ai/llms.txt, https://www.forlex.ai/llms-full.txt, and https://www.forlex.ai/sitemap.xml for canonical public content.
